notes.title: BIG VALIUPDATE!
notes.content:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR56amWYAAedR-?format=jpg&name=large[/img]

[h1][b]ValiDate has a big update coming this December![/b][/h1]

[h2][b]New features:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Rhythm mini-game 🎶
[*] Auto-Save 💾
[*] Skip to the next choice button ⏩
[*] Updated character outfits 👗
[*] Different font options 👓
[*] End card indicators
[*] Hot-keys
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Typos
[*] Sprite fixes
[*] Fishing Mini Game randomizer 
[/list]

[h1][b]RHYTHM MINI-GAME[/b][/h1]

ValiDate's rhythm mini-game allows players to play as Malik as he DJs his set for the gala in the MalikRocky route! 🎶

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR8UnTWIBMizAb?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR8hEjWIAYSNpt?format=jpg&name=large[/img]

Players will have a choice to play:

[list]
[*] Coochie Man
[*] Yo Gabba Gabba
[*] Malik's Anthem
[/list]

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR8fY9WQAAKREc?format=jpg&name=large[/img]

[h1][b]AUTO-SAVE[/b][/h1]

Auto-save is coming to ValiDate!

At every choice, the game automatically saves! 💾

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR-DB9XkAA-MEc?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR-EoDWYAAkUUh?format=jpg&name=large[/img]

[h1][b]Skip to next choice button![/b][/h1]

Players are given the option to skip choices to get their desired endings!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR-bRbXgAEPIDA?format=jpg&name=small[/img]

[h1][b]Different font options![/b][/h1]

Players have a choice of:

[list]
[*] Dosis (original font)
[*] Open Dyslexic 
[*] Roboto
[/list]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiSCnl4WIAgyODN?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiSCqdhaEAAKQSe?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiSCsXVXoAY8O9S?format=jpg&name=large[/img]

[h1][b]End card indicators[/b][/h1]

We added end-card indicators to let players know what ending they got!

The good, bad and rare ending for the MalikArihi route!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiSDzCGWIAITZ96?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiSDz4uWIA44KtO?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiSD0ZIWIAgnKNV?format=jpg&name=large[/img]

[b]Along with a few more quality-of-life, typo, and bug fixes!

Thank you for all of the love and support for ValiDate; we really appreciate it!💗[/b]

notes.title: Major update 9-25-2022
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We just had a major Steam Update that should fix every issue you have with the game. Please update your game!


What we fixed:

[list]
[*] Added cloud save to fix save issues after update.
[*] Content warning list to the main menu (a button will be added to the options menu in a future update).
[*] Prologue at a lower volume.
[/list]


As always, any remaining bugs or typos can be [url=https://forms.gle/4KThHrLvewq66vQi8]submitted here[/url]! Thank you all for being so patient with us as we figure things out, we really appreciate it!

notes.title: Major update 8-24-2022
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We just had a major Steam Update that should fix every issue you have with the game. Please update your game!


What we fixed:

[list]
[*] Load time is faster, like a lot faster. We are looking at a ~40-50% cut load time to boot up the game. 
[*] Added the sprite to Inaya's CG gallery  
[*] Fixed some typos.
[*] Fixed sprite missing errors and positioning for all characters 
[*] Side character introductions no longer cause sprites to go missing. 
[*] Updated Fishing mini-game. 
[*] Updated the phone to remove the contacts button since it is currently not working.
[/list]


As always, any remaining bugs or typos can be [url=https://forms.gle/4KThHrLvewq66vQi8]submitted here[/url]! Thank you all for being so patient with us as we figure things out, we really appreciate it!
